rows.quote: The summary data of GWAS can be downloaded from the FinnGen database (R9 release) at https://www.finngen.fi/en/access_results.
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the R9 release of the FinnGen database for the GWAS summary data.
Passages name the biobank and cite a general governance web page with no DOI, PMID or PMC identifier; no GWAS release, pipeline, sample size or accession.

rows.quote: In this population-based and prospective study, a total of 2004 significant proteins were identified in European American individuals.
rows.reference_quote: Zhang J Dutta D Köttgen A Tin A Schlosser P Grams ME Plasma proteome analyses in individuals of European and African ancestry identify cis-pQTLs and models for proteome-wide association studies Nat Genet 2022 54 5 593 602 10.1038/s41588-022-01051-w 35501419 PMC9236177
rows.coder_note: Reference 17 (DOI of both ARIC rows) is attributed in the preceding sentence of the same passage; the pinned sentence describes that study's data as European American, which separates the two rows. For the checker: the citation marker and the ancestry sit in adjacent sentences, not one.

rows.quote: The pQTLs were extracted from the deCODE study in which genome-wide association studies (GWASs) of 4907 plasma proteins were measured in 35,559 Icelanders by using SomaScan multiplex aptamer assay (version 4) [15].
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives the exact sample size 35,559 with SomaScan version 4 and 4907 proteins; matches one row and conflicts with none.
